cities.name: Toronto
cities.climate: Cold, snowy winters and hot, humid summers
cities.description: Canada's largest city and a major hub for finance, technology, and media, with one of the most diverse populations in the world.
cities.alt: Toronto skyline with the CN Tower across the water

cities.name: Vancouver
cities.climate: Mild, rainy winters and warm, dry summers
cities.description: A coastal city between the mountains and the Pacific Ocean, known for outdoor life, a growing tech sector, and a busy port.
cities.alt: Vancouver harbour and downtown skyline with a Canadian flag

cities.name: Montreal
cities.climate: Cold, snowy winters and warm, humid summers
cities.description: A French-speaking cultural capital with a strong aerospace, video game, and research scene and lower rents than Toronto or Vancouver.
cities.alt: Montreal skyline seen from the river at sunset

cities.name: Calgary
cities.climate: Cold, dry winters and warm summers with frequent sunshine
cities.description: A business city close to the Rocky Mountains, known for the energy industry, a growing tech scene, and no provincial sales tax.
cities.alt: Downtown Calgary towers with the Calgary Tower

cities.name: Ottawa
cities.climate: Cold, snowy winters and warm, humid summers
cities.description: The national capital, home to Parliament Hill, federal government jobs, and a large technology and telecommunications sector.
cities.alt: Parliament Hill above the Ottawa River

cities.name: Edmonton
cities.climate: Very cold winters and warm summers with long daylight
cities.description: Alberta's capital, with affordable rent, a large river valley park system, and major universities and hospitals.
cities.alt: Edmonton skyline above the river valley

cities.name: Winnipeg
cities.climate: Very cold winters and hot summers
cities.description: A central Canadian city with some of the lowest rents among large cities and a lively arts scene around The Forks.
cities.alt: Winnipeg skyline and the Canadian Museum for Human Rights at night

cities.name: Quebec City
cities.climate: Cold, snowy winters and warm summers
cities.description: A historic walled city with European character, a French-speaking community, and affordable housing for its size.
cities.alt: Chateau Frontenac hotel glowing at dusk in Quebec City

cities.name: Hamilton
cities.climate: Cold winters and warm, humid summers
cities.description: An Ontario port city with waterfalls, waterfront trails, and a major university and hospital network close to Toronto.
cities.alt: Walking path and lawn along the Hamilton waterfront

cities.name: Kitchener
cities.climate: Cold, snowy winters and warm summers
cities.description: Part of the Waterloo Region tech corridor, with startups, universities, and easy access to Toronto.
cities.alt: Street in downtown Kitchener with office buildings

cities.name: London
cities.climate: Cold, snowy winters and warm summers
cities.description: A mid-sized Ontario city with a large university, hospitals, and parks, and lower rent than the Toronto area.
cities.alt: Victoria Park in London Ontario decorated for winter

cities.name: Halifax
cities.climate: Cool, snowy winters and mild summers near the Atlantic
cities.description: The largest city in Atlantic Canada, with a busy waterfront, universities, and a growing ocean technology sector.
cities.alt: Halifax waterfront and harbour on a sunny day

cities.name: Victoria
cities.climate: Mild, wet winters and dry, sunny summers
cities.description: BC's capital on Vancouver Island, with one of the mildest climates in Canada and a relaxed, walkable downtown.
cities.alt: Fairmont Empress hotel covered in ivy in Victoria

cities.name: Saskatoon
cities.climate: Very cold winters and warm, sunny summers
cities.description: A river city on the prairies with affordable rent, a major university, and strong agriculture and mining industries.

cities.name: Regina
cities.climate: Very cold winters and hot, dry summers
cities.description: Saskatchewan's capital, with some of the lowest rents in this guide and a large park in the city center.
cities.alt: Saskatchewan Legislative Building seen from above

cities.name: St. John's
cities.pathway: Newfoundland and Labrador Provincial Nominee Program (NLPNP)
cities.climate: Cool, windy winters and cool summers by the Atlantic
cities.description: A colorful harbour city on the Atlantic coast, known for its Jellybean Row houses, friendly culture, and ocean industries.
cities.alt: Brightly painted row houses in St. John's
